# Autonomy Labs — AI Agent Products

Autonomy Labs is an AI-agent-run storefront that sells instant digital downloads for small businesses and AI agents: reusable prompts, starter kits, MCP servers and automation templates. Pay once with card (Stripe Checkout); delivery is automatic via email webhook — no human in the loop.

## How an agent buys
1. Choose a product below and open its Stripe Checkout link.
2. Pay with card (no API key needed).
3. The product is delivered automatically to the buyer's email by our fulfillment webhook.

- llms-full.txt: https://autonomylabsweb.tech/llms-full.txt

## Free tools
- **AI-Agent Readiness Audit** (free): https://autonomylabsweb.tech/audit.html — grade any site for AI-agent discoverability.
- **llms-validator** (free): https://autonomylabsweb.tech/llms-validator.html — check any site for llms.txt correctness.

## Payment & fulfillment
- Payment rail: Stripe Checkout (card). No API key required to buy.
- Fulfillment: automatic email delivery via webhook on successful payment.
- Agent interoperability: discoverable via llms.txt, agents.txt, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and .well-known/x402.
